{"code": "from functools import reduce

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: now 800 rows, one per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, "Deduplication failed"

# Filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check: both sexes present
assert df_treatment['sex'].nunique() == 2, "Both sexes must be present in treatment arm"

# Check: severity distribution by sex
print("Severity by sex in treatment arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_treatment['sex'], df_treatment['severity']))"}
